title: Decimal to Fraction Calculator
description: Convert any decimal number into a simplified fraction and its equivalent percentage.

formula.summary: A decimal is written as a whole number over a power of 10 matching its number of decimal places, then reduced to lowest terms.

variables.meaning: Determines the power of 10 used as the initial denominator

faqs.question: Does this handle repeating decimals?
faqs.answer: It converts up to 10 decimal places of precision as entered. True infinitely repeating decimals (like 0.333...) need a different algebraic method to express exactly, but entering enough digits gives a very close approximation.

faqs.question: Can I convert a fraction back to a decimal instead?
faqs.answer: Yes - use the Fraction Calculator, which also shows the decimal equivalent of any fraction result.

seoContent.heading: Converting decimals to fractions
seoContent.body: Every terminating decimal can be written exactly as a fraction: count the digits after the decimal point, put the number (without the decimal point) over 1 followed by that many zeros, then simplify. This calculator automates that process and reduces the result using the greatest common divisor.

seoContent.heading: Fractions, decimals, and percentages are the same value
seoContent.body: 3/4, 0.75, and 75% all represent the exact same quantity expressed three different ways. Being able to convert fluidly between them is useful across cooking measurements, financial calculations, and everyday math.
